description: A search that states NO target seniority (e.g. 'Backend Engineer' with no level). level_fit is null for everyone, so the gate must NOT fire on anyone — a guard that the eligibility gate does not over-reach when there is no level to be eligible against. Even an obvious Director must be admitted here, because the search never asked for a level.
rules: DRAFT: level_fit null -> admit (no target seniority). The gate is inert for this JD by design.
